results.title: Cameroon families demand return of relatives from Ukraine
results.content: In Cameroon, the “Bring Back Our Sons and Brothers” collective organised a peaceful march on Wednesday, 28 October, to the Russian embassy. They are calling on Russia and the Cameroonian government to work together to dismantle networks recruiting Cameroonians clandestinely into the Russian army.

results.title: Libya’s central bank targeted in overnight raid raising fresh concerns
results.content: Libya's central bank on Thursday said unidentified individuals raided its headquarters in Tripoli, hours after parliament said it had accepted a request from its governor to resign.

results.title: No clear majority emerges as Israel counts final election votes
results.content: The Israeli Elections Committee continued counting votes on Thursday from envelopes cast by voters authorized to vote outside their assigned polling stations.

results.title: Cubans call for lifting of embargo, express hope for better lives
results.content: Cuban citizens expressed hope that the US will respond to the calls of the international community as soon as possible and voiced their wishes for better lives, after the United Nations General Assembly adopted a resolution for the 34th consecutive time urging the US to end its embargo.

results.title: DRC: US sanctions on Rwanda draw mixed reactions in Goma
results.content: In Goma, some residents want to believe that this additional pressure could help break the deadlock. Michel Kamango hopes the sanctions will affect the parties concerned and help bring about a return to peace.

results.title: Putin hails 'natural allies' at Russia-Africa summit in Moscow
results.content: President Putin welcomed nearly two dozen African leaders to the Kremlin on Wednesday for a two-day Russia-Africa summit.

results.title: Vatican: Century of Mercedes-Benz popemobiles goes on display
results.content: From silk-lined limousines to vehicles fitted with bulletproof glass, eight historic popemobiles go on display at the Vatican Museums. The exhibition traces how papal transport has evolved over nearly a century.

results.title: French music producer awaits trial six years after police beating
results.content: Six years after being violently beaten by three police officers, Michel Zecler is awaiting the opening of their trial on 9 November in Paris. The music producer says he remains deeply scarred and angry over police violence.

results.title: Gabon oil rig disaster: Three bodies found, two still missing
results.content: Three bodies have been found following the sinking of an oil rig off the coast of Gabon on Saturday, while the search continues for two people still missing, according to an updated toll released by Gabonese authorities overnight from Wednesday to Thursday.

results.title: DRC Ebola clinic celebrates departure of last confirmed cases
results.content: Medical staff were joined by local residents as they celebrated the departure of the last Ebola patients from a treatment center in DR Congo’s Ituri province. It’s the first time the Médicins Sans Frontières-run clinic has had no confirmed Ebola cases since the outbreak was declared in May.

results.title: A year after Tanzania’s bloody election, victims still await justice
results.content: A year after Tanzania's bloody election, many remain traumatised by the violence, while government critics live in fear of abduction and arbitrary arrest, or facing treason and terrorism charges.

results.title: Albania: opposition MPs disrupt parliament with smoke flares
results.content: Opposition MPs disrupted a parliamentary session in Albania by brandishing smoke flares and displaying photographs of injured protesters. They accused police of using violence against demonstrators demanding Prime Minister Edi Rama's resignation.

results.title: Rembrandt's masterpieces become tattoos in the Netherlands
results.content: Visitors to the Rembrandt House Museum in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, can once again take home a piece of the Dutch master's art, permanently tattooed on their skin.

results.title: Cameroonian opposition parties condemn the suspension of Issa Tchiroma’s party
results.content: Cameroonian opposition parties condemned the three-month suspension of Issa Tchiroma Bakary’s political party, the National Salvation Front of Cameroon.

results.title: Senegal: What strategies to tackle the debt? [Business Africa]
results.content: Senegal is stepping up negotiations with international creditors to ease its public debt burden, estimated at nearly 130% of GDP in 2025, according to the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

results.title: Brazilians divided after defeated candidate Bolsonaro flees to US
results.content: As Brazilian media reported the news that defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro had fled to the US, public opinion remained divided. The 45-year-old former senator is under investigation over allegations of corruption, money laundering and tax evasion.

results.title: Ghana says Russia has backed its bid to join BRICS as a partner country
results.content: Accra is seeking partner status in the bloc of emerging economies, hoping to attract investment, expand trade, and strengthen its economy.

results.title: Israel: protesters demand Arab-Jewish unity government after election
results.content: Protesters took to the streets of Tel Aviv to demand a government bringing together Jewish and Arab parties. With Israel's election producing no clear winner, police moved in to disperse activists blocking traffic.

results.title: Tunisian journalist sentenced to four years in jail on terrorism charges
results.content: International journalism organisations have condemned Zied el-Heni's conviction on terrorism offenses saying its an escalation of Tunisia's assault on the press.

results.title: Libya's eastern administration bans nationals from Iran and Afghanistan
results.content: Libya’s Government of National Stability that controls the country’s east has barred citizens of Iran and Afghanistan from entering its territory.

results.title: Spain: cranes clear twisted train wreckage as rescuers work through the night
results.content: Rescue teams worked through the night at the site of a train collision that killed 68 people near Toledo. Cranes continued clearing the wreckage as authorities set up a temporary morgue to identify victims.

results.title: 6 million in Haiti face severe hunger amid violence, displacement and El Niño
results.content: Aid organisations in Haiti are introducing a new programme to help people get enough to eat. Nearly six million people in the Caribbean nation are experiencing severe hunger, according to a new UN-backed report. Almost two million are facing emergency levels of food insecurity.

results.title: US imposes sanctions on Rwandan defence ministry over links to Congo rebels
results.content: Washington hopes to increase pressure on Kigali to withdraw its troops from the DRC and end support for the M23 group.

results.title: Bahamas: King Charles III dances with locals during Caribbean visit
results.content: King Charles III showed off his dance moves during a colourful Junkanoo street parade in Nassau, the capital of the Bahamas, on Wednesday, 28 October, as part of his first Caribbean tour since becoming monarch.

results.title: Calls for slavery reparations grow louder as British king visits Caribbean
results.content: King Charles III's nine-day visit is being overshadowed by increasingly vocal demands for Britain to pay for its role in the slave trade.

results.title: Russia-Africa Summit: Putin seeks to expand ties with the continent
results.content: At the plenary session, Vladimir Putin told delegates that Moscow was Africa's best partner, calling for an end to Western domination.

results.title: Spain: Madrid mourns train crash victims as rescuers work through the night
results.content: Spain reels from the deadly Toledo high-speed train collision that killed 68 and injured more than 100, sparking grief, protests and calls for resignations.

results.title: Palestinian citizens of Israel hope election results bring change
results.content: Palestinian citizens of Israel expressed optimism on Wednesday following the strong showing of Arab parties in the elections.

results.title: Recreatrales festival transforms Ouagadougou neighbourhood
results.content: In Ouagadougou, an entire neighbourhood brings the Récréâtrales theatre festival to life. For its 14th edition, running from October 24 to 31, residents of Bougsemtenga are hosting performances in their courtyards.
